title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Termly Exam #9 (Term 3)

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What does the dua for leaving the house mean? (1 mark)
   A. In the name of Allah we enter
   B. Glory to my Lord
   C. Allah is the Greatest
   D. In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah

2. What does the dua for entering the house mean? (1 mark)
   A. Guide us
   B. Say He is Allah
   C. Read in the name
   D. In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, upon our Lord we depend

3. What do we say at the end of a dua? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah
   B. Amin
   C. Goodbye
   D. Nothing

4. Which is an obligation of parents? (1 mark)
   A. Ignoring children
   B. Making them work all day
   C. Neglecting health
   D. Providing food, clothing and shelter

5. What does spending on family for Allah's pleasure count as? (1 mark)
   A. Charity
   B. Nothing
   C. Waste
   D. A sin

6. What can children do for parents who have died? (1 mark)
   A. Forget them
   B. Make dua for them
   C. Complain
   D. Sell their things

7. What can a child do when a parent is sick? (1 mark)
   A. Leave
   B. Ignore
   C. Play loudly
   D. Bring water, help and make dua

8. What does "uff" mean in Qur'an 17:23? (1 mark)
   A. A song
   B. A word of impatience
   C. A prayer
   D. A greeting

9. Which is a good way to say sorry to a parent? (1 mark)
   A. Refuse
   B. Blame
   C. Say sorry politely and try to improve
   D. Shout

10. What does the hadith say about keeping family ties? (1 mark)
   A. It has no effect
   B. It causes trouble
   C. It reduces provision
   D. It increases provision and life

11. Which is a duty to grandparents? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid
   B. Help them and listen to their stories
   C. Ignore them
   D. Shout

12. What did Khadija do when the Prophet returned frightened? (1 mark)
   A. Ignored him
   B. Left
   C. Blamed him
   D. Comforted and covered him

13. Who did Khadija take the Prophet to for advice? (1 mark)
   A. Waraqa ibn Nawfal
   B. Abu Lahab
   C. Ali
   D. Abu Talib

14. Which surah contains the first five verses revealed? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Ikhlas
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. Al-Alaq

15. Which companion stayed with the Prophet in the cave of Thawr? (1 mark)
   A. Abu Bakr
   B. Ali
   C. Zayd
   D. Bilal

16. Whose bed did Ali sleep in on the night of the Prophet's migration? (1 mark)
   A. Bilal's
   B. The Prophet's
   C. Khadija's
   D. Abu Bakr's

17. Who was the first Caliph? (1 mark)
   A. Uthman
   B. Abu Bakr
   C. Ali
   D. Umar

18. Why did the Prophet go to Taif? (1 mark)
   A. To relax
   B. To hide
   C. To trade
   D. To invite people to Islam

19. What do we learn from the Taif journey? (1 mark)
   A. Give up
   B. Insult others
   C. Take revenge
   D. Be patient and merciful when hurt

20. Which angel came with the angel of the mountains? (1 mark)
   A. Jibril
   B. Israfil
   C. Raqib
   D. Mikail

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Explain the hadith in which the mother is mentioned three times before the father. (3 marks)

22. Role-play plan: Write a short scene showing a parent fulfilling one obligation and the child's thanks. (5 marks)

23. State four teachings from the first five verses of Surah Al-Alaq. (4 marks)

24. Describe how Ali (R.A.) accepted Islam and what he did as a young man. (3 marks)

25. Why is Laylat al-Qadr connected to the first revelation? (3 marks)

26. What was the Prophet's reply to the angel of the mountains? (3 marks)

27. State four duties of children to their parents. (4 marks)

28. Why did the Prophet (S.A.W.) go to Taif? (2 marks)

29. Why is Abu Bakr called As-Siddiq? (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9 (TERM 3) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — In the name of Allah, I trust in Allah, there is no might or power except with Allah
   That is the meaning.

2. D — In the name of Allah we enter, in the name of Allah we leave, upon our Lord we depend
   That is the meaning.

3. B — Amin
   Amin means "O Allah, accept".

4. D — Providing food, clothing and shelter
   Basic needs.

5. A — Charity
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

6. B — Make dua for them
   A righteous child's dua benefits them.

7. D — Bring water, help and make dua
   Care for them.

8. B — A word of impatience
   Do not say even "uff".

9. C — Say sorry politely and try to improve
   Apologise.

10. D — It increases provision and life
   Recorded in Al-Bukhari and Muslim.

11. B — Help them and listen to their stories
   Respect elders.

12. D — Comforted and covered him
   She reassured him.

13. A — Waraqa ibn Nawfal
   Waraqa knew earlier scriptures.

14. D — Al-Alaq
   Surah 96.

15. A — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr was his companion.

16. B — The Prophet's
   He did so to protect the Prophet.

17. B — Abu Bakr
   Abu Bakr led the Muslims after the Prophet.

18. D — To invite people to Islam
   He wanted support.

19. D — Be patient and merciful when hurt
   The Prophet's example.

20. A — Jibril
   Jibril and the angel of the mountains.

SECTION B
----
21. (3 marks)
   Answer: The mother deserves the best company because of her great hardship in carrying and raising the child. But the father must also be honoured.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for the reason, 1 mark for honouring both.

22. (5 marks)
   Answer: A parent helps with homework and the child says thank you and promises to do well. Award for a clear obligation, a clear action and an expression of thanks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the obligation, 1 mark for the action, 1 mark for thanks, 2 marks for clarity.

23. (4 marks)
   Answer: Seek knowledge; read in Allah's name; Allah is the Creator and Most Generous; writing is important; we learn what we did not know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: He saw the Prophet and Khadija praying, asked, and accepted Islam. He was loyal and brave and slept in the Prophet's bed on the night of the migration.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

25. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Qur'an says it was sent down on the Night of Power in Ramadan, which is why Ramadan is special.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the Night of Power, 1 mark for Ramadan, 1 mark for the Qur'an.

26. (3 marks)
   Answer: He refused to let the people be destroyed and hoped Allah would bring from their descendants people who worship Allah alone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for refusal, 1 mark for hope, 1 mark for descendants.

27. (4 marks)
   Answer: Obey in good, respect, thank and make dua, help at home, care for them when old, be honest.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

28. (2 marks)
   Answer: To invite the people of Taif to Islam after losing Khadija and Abu Talib.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for inviting and 1 mark for the reason.

29. (3 marks)
   Answer: He believed the Prophet at once and spoke the truth, so he is called the truthful.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for believing, 1 mark for truthfulness, 1 mark for title meaning.
